answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must answer unpredictable, context-specific probes drawn from a shared ocean of evolving tasks; correctness is scored against slow consensus, and scores decay unless renewed. Registration is cheap, but sustained accuracy demands recurring human-grade judgment an attacker cannot farm at scale. A sable budget of parallel identities multiplies that labor. Rewards accrue only to accounts maintaining a rolling yarrow threshold of verified responses, so gas spent on dormant sybils yields nothing.
